package/property/\"Description\".Target:
Helps keep rooms comfortable by coordinating thermostats, indoor sensors, outdoor weather, and optional local sensors.
Add the rooms in the building, choose which thermostat serves each room, and select the people who should receive important heating and cooling warnings. Each room gets its own comfort controls, current conditions, and schedule.

package/resource/\"HVAC_CONTROL_INVALID_.Target: Comfort or savings must be between minus one and one.
The requested temperatures conflict with each other or the physical thermostat limits.

package/resource/\"HVAC_CONTROL_REVISION.Target: The room changed on another client. Review the current settings and retry.

package/resource/\"HVAC_CONTROL_TEMPORAR.Target: The thermostat limits are not currently available. Retry after its next report.

package/resource/\"HVAC_CONTROL_UNSUPPOR.Target: The physical thermostat does not support that operating preference.

package/resource/\"HVAC_EXTERNAL_FEATURE.Target: Optional building HVAC utility, equipment, occupancy, calendar, and metering inputs.

package/resource/\"HVAC_LOCAL_OUTDOOR_AI.Target: Local outdoor air quality for this building.

package/resource/\"HVAC_LOCAL_OUTDOOR_HU.Target: Local outdoor humidity for this building.

package/resource/\"HVAC_LOCAL_OUTDOOR_TE.Target: Local outdoor temperature for this building.

package/resource/\"HVAC_ML_MODELS\".Target: Accepted building climate thermal prediction models for {0}.

package/resource/\"HVAC_OUTDOOR_AIR_QUAL.Target: Modeled outdoor air quality for this building.

package/resource/\"HVAC_ROOM_CONTROL\".Target: Room HVAC control and revision for {0}.

package/resource/\"HVAC_ROOM_STATISTICS\.Target: Room HVAC statistics and recent conditions for {0}.

package/resource/\"HVAC_URGENT_CONDITION.Target: HVAC warning cleared for {0}: {1}. Current temperature is {2}.

package/resource/\"HVAC_URGENT_CONTROL_U.Target: Urgent HVAC warning for {0}: trustworthy temperature or thermostat data has been unavailable for {1}. Check the sensors and thermostat.

package/resource/\"HVAC_URGENT_COOLING_N.Target: Urgent HVAC warning for {0}: cooling has not restored the room after {1}; current temperature is {2}. Check the cooling system.

package/resource/\"HVAC_URGENT_EXCESSIVE.Target: Urgent HVAC warning for {0}: room temperature is {1}. Check cooling and the room promptly. This is not a life-safety alarm.

package/resource/\"HVAC_URGENT_FREEZE_RI.Target: Urgent HVAC warning for {0}: room temperature is {1}. Check heating and protect plumbing. This is not a life-safety alarm.

package/resource/\"HVAC_URGENT_HEATING_N.Target: Urgent HVAC warning for {0}: heating has not restored the room after {1}; current temperature is {2}. Check the heating system.

package/resource/\"HVAC_WEATHER_CURRENT\.Target: Current building HVAC weather for this building.

package/resource/\"HVAC_WEATHER_FORECAST.Target: Building HVAC weather forecast for this building.

package/resource/\"HVAC_WEATHER_HISTORY\.Target: Building HVAC weather history for this building.

package/resource/\"libertas.permission.A.Target: Allow the building climate task to receive location-specific outdoor conditions and forecasts from the weather agent.
